title: Raise drain max_concurrency ceiling from 8 to 16
summary: Change MAX_CONCURRENCY_CEILING in athena-data config from 8 to 16 so [drain]/[parallel] max_concurrency accepts 1 to 16 and 17 is refused with a 1-to-16 message. Update tests, the stated range in docs and CHANGELOG; leave the athena.toml value (2) alone. Audience: the operator running athena drain and reviewers.

defaults_applied.how: Tests for 16 loads and 17 refused; cargo test and clippy pass.
Criteria run tests and drain --help to check the ceiling behavior.
Only the ceiling; plan-group recording excluded.
One constant drives the error and help; docs stating the range are updated too.
Verifier runs cargo test, clippy, fmt and help.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: crates/athena-data/src/config.rs defines MAX_CONCURRENCY_CEILING (line 269, =8), used by validate for [parallel] max_concurrency (line 722), the ConfigError::Parallel message (line 588, which interpolates the constant) and by tests near lines 1438-1466; crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs (lines 553-563, test near 1853) fills the drain --help ceiling from the constant. No record or data file is added, so no record allow-list is involved.

The constant also bounds the pipeline max_in_flight (config.rs line 745), so max_in_flight's ceiling rises to 16 too; docs that state 'max_in_flight 1 to 8 (the [parallel] ceiling)' (async-drain.md line 264) are updated to 16 for consistency. max_check_slots 1 to 8 is a separate limit and is left at 8 unless it is tied to the constant.

Docs stating the range of the built drain: docs/design/async-drain.md (lines 20, 24, 264), docs/design/parallel-jobs.md (line 10). agent-and-build-slots.md already says the ceiling is raised in build job 6 and may need a status note only if it states 8. Historical CHANGELOG entries and decisions.md records are not rewritten.
The stale '1 to 8' comment in athena.toml is a comment only; the max_concurrency = 2 value stays. Its edit is optional.
The change refuses a narrower set, not more: it admits 9 to 16 that were refused before, so no newly refused readings are expected (0% of newly refused readings).

acceptance_criteria.text: Run cargo test -p athena-data: a test shows max_concurrency = 16 loads and max_concurrency = 17 is refused with an error text containing '1 to 16'; all tests pass.
Run cargo test -p athena-cli and cargo run -- drain --help (or the existing help test): the help text states the ceiling as 16 and not 8.
cargo clippy --all-targets and cargo fmt --check are clean.
Grep of docs/design/async-drain.md and docs/design/parallel-jobs.md finds no remaining statement of 'max_concurrency' or its range as 1 to 8; they say 16.
The diff to athena.toml, if any, changes only a comment; max_concurrency = 2 is unchanged.
CHANGELOG.md has one new entry that states only what the diff does (ceiling 8 to 16, error and help text, docs updated) and does not mention recording plan group sizes.
No code or docs add plan group size recording.

out_of_scope: Rewriting historical CHANGELOG entries or decisions.md records
departures: Small mechanical change with one constant; slightly higher pass odds than reference, but doc-sweep misses are the main risk.
